reason: An Xcode-focused DSH agent preset and installer that integrates Apple’s MCP bridge, locally generated Apple development skills, and tools for Xcode project editing, configuration, diagnostics, testing setup, and localization.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供面向 Xcode 的智能体预设、Apple 开发技能和 MCP 工具，用于辅助项目编辑、配置、诊断、测试设置与本地化管理。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with an Xcode-focused agent preset, locally generated Apple development skills, and MCP tools for project editing, configuration, diagnostics, test setup, and localization.

capabilities: Installs a DSH agent preset and generates Apple platform skills from the local Xcode installation
Exposes Xcode MCP tools for reading, writing, updating, moving, removing, and searching project files
Changes Xcode targets, build settings, compiler flags, schemes, run destinations, test plans, and localization catalogs
Reads Xcode diagnostics and current workspace or window state
